summary: Master treasury management and cash forecasting with practical tools, rolling forecasts, and liquidity controls. Train your team today.
lede: Cash forecasting in treasury management helps finance professionals estimate future cash positions and plan liquidity. For staff working with cash, bank or treasury data, the course covers building rolling forecasts, analyzing cash drivers and forecast variances, and testing liquidity under different scenarios. Exercises also address payment controls and management reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who already work with cash, bank, or treasury data and need a more disciplined way to forecast, control, and report liquidity.
modules: Cash forecasting methods and variance control
prerequisites: You need a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed, or equivalent spreadsheet software, and the ability to work with sample cash data and bank movement files. No coding, statistical software, or prior treasury system access is required, although familiarity with TMS, ERP exports, or bank statements will help you move faster.
